text_excerpt: Profile --> Samuel David Stewart Studies Ethos Precision Medicine Umbrella Study for Hemangiosarcoma (Ethos-PUSH) Ethos-PUSH: Hemangiosarcoma Ethos Precision Medicine Umbrella Study for Hemangiosarcoma (Ethos-PUSH) Ethos-PUSH: Hemangiosarcoma Canine splenic hemangiosarcoma is an aggressive cancer with limited treatment options available. Dogs presenting with this disease often have spontaneous internal bleeding that results in sudden onset of weakness or collapse. Although this is a common consequence for hemangiosarcoma, any other tumor of the spleen can spontaneously bleed resulting in these same changes. Dogs who have a bleeding splenic tumor must undergo surgery to remove the spleen (called splenectomy). This procedure both removes the source of life-threatening hemorrhage and provides tissue samples for making a final diagnosis.
